set_pixels.name: Set bulb colours
set_pixels.description: Colour every bulb at once, starting at the plug.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: List of colours, one per bulb, as "#rrggbb" or [r, g, b].

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Repeat the list along the whole string.

play_sequence.name: Play sequence
play_sequence.description: Play an xLights .fseq file on every string, without xLights running.

file.name: Sequence file
file.description: Path to the .fseq file. Relative names are looked up in /media/xlights, then /config/www/xlights.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Start again from the beginning when the sequence ends. With a speaker, the speaker's repeat setting decides instead.

media_player.name: Speaker
media_player.description: Media player (e.g. a Music Assistant player) to play the music on. The lights follow its playback position, pause when it pauses and stop when it stops or changes song.

audio.name: Audio
audio.description: What to play on the speaker: any media content ID it accepts, e.g. a Music Assistant URI (library://track/…, spotify://track/…), a URL or a media-source:// ID.

audio_offset.name: Offset
audio_offset.description: Seconds to shift the lights later (positive) or earlier (negative), to fine-tune for speaker lag. Without a speaker, a delay before the lights start.

stop_sequence.name: Stop sequence
stop_sequence.description: Stop the playing sequence and turn the bulbs dark.

set_mask.name: Keep bulbs off
set_mask.description: Choose bulbs that stay dark under everything this light shows (effects, patterns, zones and shows), such as one in front of a window. Identify and the camera scan still light them.

bulbs.name: Bulbs
bulbs.description: Bulb numbers and ranges, counted from the plug, like 3, 7-12. Empty turns them all back on.

set_pattern.name: Set pattern
set_pattern.description: Pick the bulbs' colour pattern, how it moves, and the speed. Speed on its own changes the speed of whatever effect is running.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Which colours the bulbs show, repeated along the string.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: How the pattern moves: Steady, Twinkle, Chase and more.

off_bulbs.name: Bulbs to keep off
off_bulbs.description: Bulb numbers and ranges, counted from the plug, like 3, 7-12, that stay dark while this pattern shows. Picking another colour, effect or pattern clears them.

start_zone.name: Start zone
start_zone.description: Show a pattern across the runs of a zone (set up in the Light Shows app, Map tab) as one thing, in sync. Give a zone, or an area to use every run in it without a saved zone. A zone keeps its lights until you pick a colour or effect on one, turn it off, or a show starts.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The zone's name or id. Give this or an area.

area.name: Area
area.description: An area's name or id: the pattern runs across every run in that area (nothing is saved). Give this or a zone.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Which colours to show. Kept as the zone's pattern.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: How the pattern moves. Kept as the zone's effect.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 1 (slow) to 100 (fast); 50 is normal. Kept as the zone's speed.

stop_zone.name: Stop zone
stop_zone.description: Stop a zone. Its lights go back to what they showed before, or turn off if the zone turned them on.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The zone's name or id. Give this or an area.

area.name: Area
area.description: An area whose pattern was started with the area field.

save_look.name: Save look
save_look.description: Save what the lights show now under a name, to bring back later (a look with that name is replaced).

entity_id.name: Lights
entity_id.description: Only save these lights. Leave empty to save every light and the running zones.

apply_look.name: Apply look
apply_look.description: Bring a saved look back on the lights. A light a show is playing on is left alone.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Seconds to fade to the look.

music_follow.name: Music: follow a speaker
music_follow.description: Make lights react to the song a speaker is playing, with no microphone. Works for songs of the show library (the media folder's xlights folder): the song is analysed once, then the lights follow the speaker's position. Ends when the speaker stops or plays something else.

media_player.name: Speaker
media_player.description: The media player that is playing the song.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Whole lights to use. Give lights, areas or both.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Areas of the map (names or ids): every run in them is used.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Which colours the music moves. A built-in pattern or one of your own.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: How the lights react: Pulse, Beat Chase, Spectrum, Flash, Beat Scatter, Gravity Drop or Beat Shell.

song.name: Song
song.description: A song in the show library (for example Show/Song.mp3). Only needed when the speaker doesn't report the library's own link, such as when another app plays the same file.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Seconds to move the lights later (positive) or earlier (negative) against the speaker's reported position.

music_stop.name: Music: stop
music_stop.description: Stop music mode (following a speaker or a phone's microphone). The lights go back to what they showed before.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Only stop music on these lights. Leave lights and areas empty to stop all.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Only stop music in these areas.
